items.item_text: High School Diploma or GED is required, or equivalent combination of education and experience. College or advanced degree is preferred.
3 years of experience in development at a major academic institution is preferred. 2 years of experience in planned giving preferred.

Is the primary to answer inbound calls from prospective Pomona Plan donors in response to advertising. Screens these calls using a cultivation script and program knowledge to answer initial questions, capture marketing source and ensure the caller is connected with the appropriate gift officer for further cultivation. Uses friendly, open, and engaging language along with substantive knowledge to put prospective donors at ease, welcome their interest and convey the expertise available within the team as a whole.
Serves on the Pomona Plan marketing subgroup and acts as liaison to the Advancement Communication team coordinator for marketing strategy, implementation and tracking.

Provides primary administrative support for the gift officers (the Senior Director, Director and Associate Director) in their cultivation and stewardship activities for life-income donors. In particular, the position finalizes and mails proposals and other responses to inquiries from donors and prospective donors.

Primary responsibility for maintaining the CRM related to donor cultivation and stewardship activities, including entering new prospects, new and updated proposals and opportunities, call reports and marketing sources and appeals .

Collaborates with the gift officers to plan visits with and other stewardship activities for our life-income donors and prospective donors. For gift officer visits away from campus, may prepare visit letters, visit files, and reports as requested by the gift officers, and may telephone donors and prospects in advance of visits and otherwise as requested by the gift officers. For donor visits to campus, negotiate schedules with campus partners to build out meaningful agendas for donors when they visit campus, serve as either the lead or the key resource for all arrangements, troubleshoot problems and provide exceptional customer service for the entirety of their visit.
After gift officers complete visits, prepares or finalizes call reports and any correspondence necessary. Enters visits in the CRM and updates other information in the CRM.
Coordinates with the gift officers on a system of reminders (through the CRM and the Outlook Calendar) for future visits and other cultivation and stewardship activities.

On a monthly basis, independently pulls the list of relevant life-income donors, develops and hand inscribes a standard birthday message on stewardship birthday cards and ensures timely mailing and CRM documentation , as needed . On an annual basis, leads the effort to send holiday gifts to select life-income donors, including pulling the list of relevant donors and interfacing with the holiday gift vendor.

Leads the office to select and procure stewardship gift items like Pomona Plan polo shirts and notebooks. Oversees and maintains the relationship with the stewardship gift vendor and ensures expenses for yearly purchases align with budget

Independently develops and pulls lists through the CRM for (i) all standard Pomona Plan print and email marketing, (ii) office statistics and metrics, and (iii) ratings and portfolio management. Provides expertise on data management questions. Also serves as lead liaison to Advancement Services for custom list pulls.

Leads the monthly close for cultivation analytics and related reporting metrics, including a report on the leading cultivation indicators. Also pulls or works with Advancement Services to pull custom reports on proposal activity and other cultivation activity as requested.
Acts as the lead point of contact with Advancement Services on CRM implementation, customization, enhancement, and maintenance
Researches and maintains a database of key industry statistics including comparative commercial annuity rate information and an IRS discount rate projection.

Serves as the primary point of contact for the Pomona Plan Office for inquiries from the Advancement division. Develops and maintains relationships with peers across the division with an eye toward spreading expertise about life-income giving. Also answers phones and routes calls from donors, prospects, beneficiaries, and others to the appropriate person in the Office or at the College.
Greets visitors. Receives, opens, date­ stamps, and routes mail received in the Office.

Assists the Senior Director, Director and Associate Director as requested to organize workflow, including picking up and routing outgoing paperwork, organizing mail, returning phone calls and other matters as requested.

Prepares correspondence and reports from various sources. Requires accurate preparation of a variety of documents and proficiency in the use of Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook and other software, as necessary.

Maintains electronic Outlook calendar for the Pomona Plan Office, reflecting staff trips, vacations and commitments. Helps lead the weekly team meeting by preparing the template agenda and collecting submissions for meeting topics. Captures notes from the weekly meeting. Works with the Senior Director to plan and execute team events such as the yearly team retreat and convocation lunch celebration.
Leads the Office in coordinating office space requirements, supplies and facilities requests.

Leads the Office on expense reporting and processing. Helps oversee and track Office expenditures against budget. Leads the Office on the project to digitize all files in the Office while ensuring that important historical data and files continue to be available as needed.
Provides clerical assistance to the donor services team on routine tasks.
Supports the donor services team as requested in maintaining the CRM related to gifts and donor services.

On a transitionary basis, until the Complex Assets and Principal Gifts Team is fully staffed, may assist as requested with bequest administration, including finalizing correspondence, preparing mailing labels, setting up files, copying and mailing, and other such clerical matters.
Maintains current knowledge of planned giving by regularly reviewing professional newsletters and publications.
Pursues training on the CRM and other database programs through Webcasts, IT seminars and other means.
Develops proficiency in general software, including MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook, and other programs as needed.
Expands training in Project Management.
Develops training in PG Calc Manager planned gift calculation software.

pay.source_text: The hourly rate for this role is $26.50 to $30.98 per hour with a competitive benefits package. The specific factors that the College will consider when offer
